note: A gate suite that depends on an absolute path outside the checkout, or invokes a binary with no capability probe, is rejected by gate:topology unless it is declared here with a reason. These entries record the pre-existing host-path suites that predate D-109's two-branch invariant; they are a visible debt ledger, not an endorsement. A new dependency must either carry a capability discriminant or add a declared entry here, which is what makes the categorical rule enforceable without asserting against one specific path.
